newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai securities industry crime down sharply.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai securities industry crime down sharply.

text.p: Only 29 criminal cases were uncovered in Shanghai's securities industry in the first 10 months of this year, down dramatically from 1995, the Shanghai Securities newspaper reported on Sunday.

The newspaper said that in the whole of 1995, there were 107 cases of criminal activity by people in the securities business in the city, including a wide range of activities including misappropriation of public funds and bribery.
It said the sharp fall in criminal activity was the result of efforts by the securities exchange and other authorities to standardise trading practices and close loopholes in the legal framework.
